document.title: The write step names the one-relation summary and the citation rule
document.summary: One sentence in step 4 of the skill says a group summary names one relation among its hunks, not a file list, and a citation carries only what its source says.
document.why: [After the parts action, the prose grader's majors rose, mostly group summaries that list files and whys that cite a source for what it does not say; both rules lived only in reference sections](source:s1).

commits.subject: Skill: the write step names the one-relation summary and the citation rule
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The prose grader's majors rose after the parts action, mostly group summaries that list files and whys that cite a source for what it does not say. Both rules lived only in the reference sections; the write step now states them.
